findings.where: packages/db/migrations/0209_preview_invite.sql:38 (and the same claim at apps/web/lib/firm/invite-preview.ts:16); the body at 0209:192-205
findings.what: 0209's header and the web reader's header both assert the preview door 'cannot show anything to a caller who could not also ACCEPT'. That is false: clara.accept_invite carries a THIRD wall that preview_invite does not reproduce — an issuer-rank re-check at accept time (`if clara.role_rank(inv.role) > coalesce(v_issuer_rank, -1) then raise ... 'invite exceeds the issuer''s rank -- re-issue by an owner' using errcode='CLR04'`). preview_invite walls only on sha256(token) + _jwt_email(), so such an invitation previews as `pending` with its full role, the password form renders, the invitee's account password is actually changed via updateUser, and only THEN accept_invite refuses. Because the check is `coalesce(v_issuer_rank, -1)`, this covers the ordinary case of an issuer who has since been demoted OR removed from the firm — i.e. every outstanding invitation issued by someone who has left. It is the exact shape D1/AC2 added the preview step to prevent ('a definite negative BLOCKS ... no password form at all').
findings.evidence: Measured on the from-scratch cluster rig625r (127.0.0.1:55601 / clara_625r, 194 migrations). Probe scratchpad/probe/p625-adv.mjs: firm admin issues an `admin`-role invite; the firm owner then runs clara.set_member_role to demote that admin to bookkeeper; then — ISSUER-DEMOTED preview = {"role":"admin","status":"pending","firm_name":"ADV A 1789503571244","masked_email":"p***@rig.test"} / ISSUER-DEMOTED accept = {"code":"CLR04","message":"invite exceeds the issuer's rank -- re-issue by an owner"}. The wall text is in the live body (read from pg_proc.prosrc for clara.accept_invite(text,text,text) on clara_625r, sha 42a1532...aeef2, which is the sha 0209 pins). preview_invite's body (0209:192-205) contains no membership lookup at all.
findings.fix: Either (a) fold the same issuer-rank lookup into 0209 §A's status computation so an unacceptable invitation reports a non-`pending` effective status and reaches the blocked face (a read of clara.firm_memberships, no lock, so the C-80 lock-order invariant is untouched) and add the face; or, minimum, (b) delete the 'cannot show anything to a caller who could not also ACCEPT' sentence from 0209:37-39 and the 'nothing is previewable that could not also be accepted' clause at apps/web/lib/firm/invite-preview.ts:16, record the issuer-rank wall as a NAMED residual in packages/db/README.md's 0209 note, and add a red-first cell to packages/db/tests/preview-invite.test.mjs that pins this exact divergence (preview=pending, accept=CLR04) so it cannot silently widen.

findings.what: §C (T.2)'s 'does not return a jsonb_build_object' guard can never fire. `v_ret := substr(v_src, position('return jsonb_build_object(' in v_src));` — when the fragment is absent, position() is 0 and substr(s, 0) returns the WHOLE source, never the empty string, so `if v_ret = ''` is dead code. The tail still fails closed by accident (the next check, `position('token' in v_ret)`, trips on the body's own `p_token`/`token_hash`), but the named guard proves nothing it claims to prove.
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL substr(string, 0) returns the whole string (start positions < 1 are clamped); 0209:270 takes the substring unconditionally and 0209:271-273 tests it for ''. The assertion is only reachable when v_src itself is empty.
findings.fix: Test the position first: `if position('return jsonb_build_object(' in v_src) = 0 then raise exception '#625 tail: clara.preview_invite does not return a jsonb_build_object' using errcode='CLR10'; end if;` and only then take the substring.

findings.where: apps/web/e2e/responsive-shell-walk.spec.ts (the new /invite/:token legs render the confirm stage only) and apps/web/components/invite-accept-form.test.tsx:924
findings.what: The preview step is the sole justification for migration 0209 (brief: 'a migration with no caller is not a delivery'), yet every proof of it is jsdom with a mocked global fetch. No browser leg — mocked OR real — ever drives /invite/:token past verifyOtp, so the first governed door call made on a session minted moments earlier (sessionTokenAccessor -> lib/session.ts getSessionToken -> supabase.auth.getSession()) is unexercised end to end. Because an INDEFINITE read degrades silently to 'password form, no preview block', a production deployment in which that token is not yet readable would look identical to a working one in all shipped evidence.
findings.evidence: apps/web/e2e/responsive-shell-walk.spec.ts's new cell asserts only the 'Accept your invitation' heading and the 'Accept invitation' button (the pre-click confirm stage); the narrow target-size loop adds the same URL. apps/web/e2e/members-lifecycle-mock.mjs declares no preview_invite verb. Every p625.web.* preview cell runs under withMockedEnv with a stubbed fetch (invite-accept-form.test.tsx:924-1099).
findings.fix: Add one e2e leg that stubs Supabase's verifyOtp response and answers /rest/v1/rpc/preview_invite from members-lifecycle-mock.mjs (declaring the verb in that lane's verb set), asserting the preview block renders above the password fields and that a revoked preview renders no password input — the brief already anticipates this ('if your walk drives past verification, declare preview_invite as that lane mock's own verb'). Keep labelling it LOCAL/mock-backed, not AC7 evidence.
